description: This file defines a report for address and contact information related to parties such as customers, suppliers, and sales partners in the ERPNext system. It includes functions to generate report columns, fetch party details, and organize address/contact data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Constructs the report columns based on the party type.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves address and contact data for specified party.

methods.name: get_party_addresses_and_contact
methods.description: Fetches and organizes address and contact details for each party.

methods.name: get_party_details
methods.description: Fetches detailed address or contact information for a list of parties.

methods.name: add_blank_columns_for
methods.description: Returns blank columns for address or contact fields.

methods.name: get_party_group
methods.description: Determines the group field name based on party type.
